hook.name: SurtHook
hook.description: ETH/SURT bonding curve hook implementing a SATO-style pricing model with dynamic sell-side burn (2–8% of fair SURT, volume/TVL-linked) and an idle jackpot mechanism (1% of each buy credited to pot; paid to prior buyer after 1 hour of inactivity). Liquidity additions are forbidden; requires the real swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData.
